Name: MIMICRY_ESTABLISHMENT_TEX_PARAM_ST
Description: Converts the colours of a painted map info texture to MapMimicryEstablishmentParam rows (Elden Ring's per-area disguise rules). NR still reads it, but its disguise effect always uses MapMimicryEstablishmentParam row 0, so it appears to have no effect. Retail: one row (255, no disguise row), unchanged from Elden Ring.
